title: Trip
description: A traveller's saved journey. revision backs optimistic concurrency: every mutation increments it and PATCH requires a matching If-Match header, so two tabs cannot silently overwrite each other.

revision.description: Monotonic revision counter, also served as the ETag.

selected_route_id.description: Route the traveller applied. Set only by apply-route, never by the client directly. A RecordId rather than a Uuid because it holds a RouteCandidate.route_id, and those are producer-minted and reproducible (`openrouteservice:3ca4459b8d41b503`) so that the same route asked for twice is recognisably the same route.

previous_selected_route_id.description: The route this trip had applied before the current one, kept so a reassessment can say what changed. Same type as selected_route_id for the same reason.

latest_request_id.description: Most recent assessment started for this trip revision.

deleted_at.description: Set by soft delete. Purge of the underlying rows happens asynchronously under the retention policy.
